mission: Closed-loop production-learning ledger — searched BEFORE every generation; preflight checks block known failures. v2 adds executable appliesWhen + guard per lesson so operating-contract.mjs enforces them (a lesson is NOT complete until the workflow reads+applies it).

guardSemantics.severity: BLOCK = refuse the paid call; WARN = allow but surface the correction; RECOVERY = non-gen protocol to run on the named event.
guardSemantics.ruleFields: model (regex op.model must match), modelNot (regex op.model must NOT match), subject (normalised equals, diacritic-insensitive), usesFaceRef (bool equals), promptIncludesAny ([substr]), promptMissingAll (op.prompt must contain NONE), event (op.event equals). A guard FIRES only when every present field matches.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: Björn identity → minimax/video-01 subject_reference (validated, consistent across 7+ shots)
mandatoryLessons.preflight: for a Björn shot, use minimax subject_reference with a Björn 768px ref

guard.message: Björn identity should route to minimax/video-01 subject_reference (not this model).

mandatoryLessons.lesson: seedance-2.5 reference_images REJECTS the Björn face with E005 (reproduced ×6, even weapon-free@768)
mandatoryLessons.preflight: NEVER route a Björn face-reference shot to seedance reference_images; seedance TEXT-ONLY (no face ref) is fine for environment

guard.message: E005: seedance face-filter rejects the Björn face ref. Route to minimax subject_reference, or use seedance TEXT-ONLY for environment.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: greatsword renders UNDERSIZED on minimax text prompts
mandatoryLessons.preflight: for hero-weapon shots use a greatsword-BEARING Björn ref + explicit 'enormous two-handed greatsword, blade taller than a man' scale constraint

guard.message: Greatsword undersizes on text prompts — add an explicit scale constraint and prefer a greatsword-bearing Björn ref.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: weak costume prompting → bare-chest / weapon drift (A2b v1)
mandatoryLessons.preflight: always include 'wool tunic (not bare chest)' + explicit weapon; run the costume/weapon continuity check on output

guard.message: Björn costume drift risk — add 'wool tunic (not bare chest)' + the explicit weapon to the prompt.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: a shell TIMEOUT does not prove a provider job failed (A4b: killed mid-call, succeeded server-side, charged)
mandatoryLessons.preflight: on timeout/interruption: do NOT retry; the ledger KEEPS the reservation; reconcile the prediction read-only (GET /predictions/{id}) before any retry — avoids double charges

guard.message: Do NOT retry. Keep the reservation. Reconcile the prediction read-only (GET /predictions/{id}); settle on success, release on failure — then resume.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: generated video is SILENT unless audio is separately generated + mixed
mandatoryLessons.preflight: do not treat a silent clip as audiovisually complete; plan CC0/TTS audio as a separate post step

guard.message: Clips are SILENT — do not claim audiovisual completion. Plan CC0/TTS audio + mix as a separate step.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: single-frame inspection is NOT full-motion acceptance
mandatoryLessons.preflight: extract first/mid/last frames for an identity/motion proxy; mark HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING until a human views playback

guard.message: A single frame is not full-motion acceptance. Keep status HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING until a human views playback.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: derivatives/assemblies must NOT be counted as independent source generations
mandatoryLessons.preflight: dedup by sha256; classify each media as GENERATED / DERIVATIVE (upscale/concat/web-copy) before counting unique source duration

guard.message: Dedup by sha256 and classify DERIVATIVE vs GENERATED before counting unique source duration.

mandatoryLessons.lesson: content-sensitivity (E005) also trips on child-in-peril + graphic weapon-into-person prompts
mandatoryLessons.preflight: no 'child' in peril prompts; frame rescue with an adult crewman; weapons as 'planted/braced', no gore

guard.message: E005 risk: child-in-peril detected. Reframe the endangered figure as an adult crewman; keep weapons 'braced/planted', no gore.

incidents.asset: git workflow (governance commit on a branch)
incidents.expected: commit governance source on a branch, then continue untracked production work on main
incidents.observed: after committing 25 files on branch governance/f11-operating-contract, `git checkout main` REMOVED those branch-only-tracked files (incl. F10_FROZEN) from main's working tree; session-resume/verifyF10 broke
incidents.billing: n/a (NO data loss — files safe in the pushed branch commit)
incidents.rootCause: CONFIRMED: files tracked in the branch but absent from main's tree are deleted from the working tree on checkout (normal git); they were untracked on main before the branch commit
incidents.correction: restored via `git checkout <branch> -- <paths>` then `git reset -- docs/film-factory/` (present + untracked on main again). Lesson: when committing a subset on a branch while the rest stays untracked on main, RESTORE the files to the working tree after switching back (or keep production work on the branch).

incidents.verified: yes (fully recovered; main 28c15a5 unmoved; branch 4d26024 on origin)

preflightProtocol: Before any paid generation: (1) confirm the shot has a timeline position + scene + purpose + acceptance test + cost ceiling; (2) search this ledger for the model+subject; (3) apply all matching preflight checks (route/ref/prompt-locks); (4) reserve worst-case; (5) generate; (6) run the regression check on the output; (7) record the result (new incident if it failed). This protocol is now EXECUTABLE via operating-contract.mjs preflightForGeneration().
